AVIATOR PRO

Dragon Tiger is a fast-paced game played with standard decks of cards. Players bet on which hand, Dragon or Tiger, will receive the higher card. The game follows simple rules, with Ace being the lowest card and King the highest.

7UP 7DOWN

7Up 7Down is a simple and exciting game. Players bet on whether the sum of two rolled dice will be over 7, under 7, or exactly 7. It's a quick-paced game with multiple betting options.

3 PATTI

3 Patti, also known as "Three Card," is a popular South Asian card game similar to poker. Players try to have the best three-card hand based on rankings like Flush, Straight, or Pair, betting until the winner takes the pot.
